trustChecks.rule: Any proof, performance, Sparkle, or fleet statement must link back to release evidence or appear in the blocked-claims section.
The marketing site must visibly state that it is a public-disclosure draft and not approved for publication.
The audience packet must exist and pass release-doctor before the site can be routed to any public publication lane.
The release packet must name Carrie CMO (cmo-chief-marketing-officer-carrie@wrkstrm.occupations.org) as the consumer-facing gate owner before the site can leave draft state.
